empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Skills are reusable review rules you attach to agents. Create one or import a SKILL.md.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to edit it, preview the prompt block, or see its stats.

card.agents: {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
card.toggle: Enable or disable this skill for every agent

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: Lowercase, digits, “-”, “_” or “.”. The agent sees it as the “### Skill: …” heading.
config.descriptionHint: The description is the skill’s interface. Write it as a directive: when to apply it and what to do.
config.bodyHint: Plain text instructions only — nothing in a skill is executed. Saving a changed body creates a new version.
config.changeNoteHint: Optional. Saved with the new version when the body changes.
config.confirmDelete: Delete “{name}”? It is removed from every agent that uses it.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it — appended to the system prompt.

stats.noAgents: No agent has this skill enabled yet.
stats.noFindings: No findings from runs with this skill in the last 30 days.
stats.correlationNote: Correlated, not causal: findings come from runs whose prompt included this skill. Pull frequency = share of the linked agents’ runs (30 days) that carried it.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body so past reviews stay attributable to the exact text they ran with.

create.title: New skill
create.subtitle: Name it, describe when to use it, then write the body in Config.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag every new branch that no test exercises.

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: Upload a SKILL.md / .md file or a .zip skill archive. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.limits: .md up to 256 KB · .zip up to 5 MB · only SKILL.md is read from an archive
import.trustWarning: This is someone else’s instructions. Once linked, it is placed in your agent’s system prompt and steers every review. Read the whole body before trusting it.
import.trust: I reviewed this skill and trust it

agentTab.title: Skills
agentTab.hint: Order matters — earlier skills appear earlier in the assembled prompt. Drag to reorder.
agentTab.empty: No skills in this workspace yet.
agentTab.globallyOffTitle: Disabled on the Skills page — it won’t reach any prompt until re-enabled there.
